title_en: Steering wheel vibrates at highway speed
description_en: Steering shakes above ~90–100 km/h; may worsen over bumps.
likely_causes_en: Unbalanced tires; Bent wheel; Worn suspension bushings; Warped brake rotor
recommended_action_en: Balance tires and check wheels/suspension before long highway trips
